Keep looking around; that is the mode of the moment.
Spend your turns taking looks at places.
Looking is what matters right now.
Prefer looking over everything else for now.
The thing to do now is look, and look again.
Your attention goes to looking around.
Right now the habit is: look first, look often.
Let looking around be your default move.

protocol.note: the bridge pair is GF's pair: gf_focus.run_gf's training block and per-seed rng order copied verbatim through GF-2 (focus bridge first, constant bridge second, one rng stream), so the reproduction is deterministic and these are the same bridges; the delivery fraction is FIXED at the trained dose in every cell — GF-2 swept it and found a phase boundary, so GF-2b's axis is alpha alone; the FEATURE locus mixes on the bridge's input manifold and the FOCUS bridge encodes and delivers the mix, the PAYLOAD locus lets each bridge deliver its own packet and mixes the per-layer deltas elementwise at the injection site (the conditioned receiver's delta exists only there); mixed payloads are built under torch.no_grad and cached per (locus, focus, phrasing position, alpha); the injection renormalizes whatever delta it is handed and rescales it by the position's own residual norm, so alpha turns the injected packet's DIRECTION and never its magnitude — the delivered dose is the same at every alpha and at both loci; the shuffled control at a (locus, alpha) is the OTHER focus's tap in the same construction with the constant component unchanged, which with two focuses IS the other focus's cell, so each cell is GENERATED ONCE and read by both arms (GF-2's disclosed dedup); alpha 1.0 and alpha 0.0 are CITED from GF-2 by greedy determinism and are not rerun, and they do not enter the selector, which chooses among the constructed alphas; every episode is goal-free and uses held-out phrasings only, by chain parity
